# Verwaltung

> The firm's administration console in the Platform, where an administrator manages people and which roles they hold, and a second person confirms guarded actions; the console's blueprint and role gates, on which the access pages (L2-PLATFORM-ACCESS) and the role builder's pages (L2-PLATFORM-ROLES, L2-PLATFORM-AGENTS) hang.

## Identity

| Id | `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN` |
| Kind | code |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Level | 2 |
| Parent | `L1-WORKSPACE` |

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN/R-1` | People (A-01, A-02): create, deactivate and activate an account (never the last active administrator), reset a password, sign a person out everywhere, set a person's roles (every role of the Rollen page, by name; her roles become exactly the checked ones, RB-4), and set a person's access groups. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_people.html`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/js/admin_people.js` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN/R-3` | Approvals: a guarded action (a document's access groups, a folder rule, erasing the corpus) is queued for a second person, who confirms or rejects it; an administrator acting alone is recorded as a bypass, and only an administrator switches the bypass. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_approvals.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/guarded.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_approvals.html` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN/R-4` | The console's one blueprint and its role gates, on which the other console pages (Zugriffsgruppen and Dokumente of L2-PLATFORM-ACCESS, Rollen of L2-PLATFORM-ROLES, Agenten of L2-PLATFORM-AGENTS, Ingestion, Dokumentfelder, System's checks) are mounted, and the console's stylesheet. The console draws no menu of its own - its pages are the entries of the navigation's area Verwaltung, which the shell draws; each page names itself to the navigation. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/css/admin.css` |

### Not responsible for

- Accounts, roles, sessions, the audit log and the approval queue's storage; the Platform's identity package (src/identity) keeps them (the roles in identity/roles.py, RB-1).
- The Rollen page (L2-PLATFORM-ROLES) and the Agenten page (L2-PLATFORM-AGENTS), whose routes hang on this blueprint and its gate.
- The access groups, the folder rules and the documents with their access groups (A-03, A-04); L2-PLATFORM-ACCESS, whose routes hang on this blueprint and its gate.
- Whether a person may read a document; the Brain decides, per customer, where enforcement is on.
- The console's Ingestion and Dokumentfelder pages and System's checks (admin_ingestion.py, admin_doc_fields.py, admin_system.py); they are mounted on this blueprint and have no card yet.
- «Was sieht …?» and the enforcement posture; today they are the Builder's (access window), and PMVP-41 and PMVP-42 bring them here.

### Terms

- guarded action (an action a second person must confirm: a document's access groups, a folder rule, erasing the corpus, an ingestion profile)
- bypass (an administrator acting alone on a guarded action, recorded as approval.bypassed)

## To review

| At | Why |
|---|---|
| `/owner` | Proposed owner, as for every card in this repository; one role per component is confirmed by a person (Software Map K4). |
| `/status` | Live or planned is not read from the code; the console is on main and runs where the Platform runs. |
| `/responsible_for` | PMVP-11 removed the row of tabs (templates/\_admin_tabs.html): one navigation. Who sees which entry is no longer a condition in a console template; the web app reads it from the gates this blueprint puts on its routes (app.py, \_admin_pages; the shell's card): each gate (\_require_roles) puts the set of roles it checks on the view it returns, as allowed_roles, and the web app reads that attribute. No gate's check changed. admin.css still holds the rules of the removed tabs (.admin .tabs) and rules that restyle the old navigation on the console's pages (.admin-page .app-sidebar and below); the shell's shell.css outranks the second group. PMVP-40 left both: neither styles a page of its own, and tests/test_shell_nav_styles.py reads the second group. |
| `/responsible_for` | PMVP-40 (2026-11-21): the people page is one column of the shared page parts (\_parts.html); the details of a person open in the panel below the list, which admin_people.js switches as before. Roles are shown in plain words (A-02), a table in the template. Marks only for exceptions: deactivated, locked and a pending password change carry a tag, an active account none. The rules of admin.css the page no longer uses are removed and listed in work order PMVP-40; .role-chip and .document-status stay in one rule only because tests/test_shell_tokens.py names them. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN/R-1` | RB-4 (2026-11-21) replaced the two boxes of keys (PMVP-40) and the key form of RB-1/RB-2: POST /admin/people/roles takes role ids (role_id) and makes the person's roles exactly the checked ones; the page offers every role of list_roles() by name, so a new installation shows Administration and Mitglied and no key anywhere. A Builder function comes from a role the page shows, so saving as drawn keeps it. Deactivating holds Administration's row and counts inside it (RoleStore.check_deactivation; coordinator's amendment F3), so a deactivation and a removal from Administration at once never leave it without an active person. No gate changed; ASSIGNABLE_ROLES stays for the tests that name it. |
| `/source_paths` | The work order's scope: the people page and the approvals PMVP-40 to PMVP-42 change. guarded.py is here because only console modules use it (admin_documents.py, admin_ingestion.py). admin.css is the stylesheet of every console page, those without a card too. PMVP-40 split the access groups, folder rules and documents (admin_documents.py, their two templates and admin_documents.js) into L2-PLATFORM-ACCESS: together the card was over its context budget, the code alone (16,724 tokens) over 16,000 (FU-17). RB-FIX-1 (FU-44) split the role builder's pages off the same way, as two cards (one would still have been about 18,900 tokens): L2-PLATFORM-ROLES (admin_roles.py and its page, R-5 and the lines of its nine routes) and L2-PLATFORM-AGENTS (admin_agents.py and its page, R-6 and the lines of its five routes), each line with its old id as its first alias; together the card was 33,409 tokens. The other console modules (admin_ingestion.py, admin_doc_fields.py, admin_system.py) and their pages stay outside (boundaries.yaml, not_carded); their domain is open (DEC-0083 names the Admin pages, not each console module): the project that cards them decides. |
| `/operations` | The routes of admin_approvals.py are attached to the blueprint admin.py passes in, so the code reader shows them without the prefix /admin (e.g. GET /approvals @web_interface.admin_approvals.bp); the refs here name the served path. Backlog row B33 of the Software Map plan. |
| `/contract` | Plan § 7 names Verwaltung only in SHELL POST-01, whose server half ("the server refuses the page otherwise") is each route's N-1 here. Every other line of these routes (what they promise, their limits) has no source in § 7: PMVP-40 to PMVP-42 write them with their page tests (A-01 to A-06). Since PMVP-40 every route's N-1 has live tests in tests/test_web_admin_gates.py: the view the app registered lets in admin alone (allowed_roles); every other role the console gives (approver, ingestion_manager, member, experimenter, experiments_manager) and an account with no role get 403 and nothing runs; an administrator gets 200. The signed-out test (302 to the sign-in) cannot catch a missing route gate on its own: the app's sign-in check answers first. |
| `/operations` | create_admin_blueprint and run_guarded have no line: plan § 7 gives none. run_guarded's two outcomes (queued, or executed and recorded as a bypass) are a candidate for PMVP-42, which needs a second administrator for the enforcement switch. |
| `/uses` | Not declared because they have no card yet: the Platform's identity package (users, passwords, audit, approvals), the web app's client (knovas_client.py) and the console modules mounted here (admin_doc_fields.py, admin_ingestion.py, admin_system.py). L2-PLATFORM-ACCESS's three names and the attach functions of L2-PLATFORM-ROLES and L2-PLATFORM-AGENTS have no line to expect: plan § 7 gives none. |
